aboutPage.seo.title: Run your restaurant business from one platform — PurpleHere
aboutPage.seo.description: From a single outlet to a hundred. Mobile orders, POS, inventory, staff, franchises, and billing — one cloud platform built for restaurant operators, brand HQs, foodcourts, and suppliers.
aboutPage.hero.title: Run your entire restaurant business from one place
aboutPage.hero.subtitle: From one outlet to a hundred. Orders, POS, inventory, staff, franchise rollout, supplier invoicing — every channel in one cloud platform.
aboutPage.problem.title: Sound familiar?
aboutPage.problem.lead: Most restaurant operators stitch together five disconnected tools every day. The data never matches, training is constant, and HQ is always playing catch-up.
aboutPage.problem.card1.title: Closing reports done in Excel every night
aboutPage.problem.card1.desc: POS, mobile orders, delivery apps — three sources, one spreadsheet, an hour of your life gone.
aboutPage.problem.card2.title: Retraining staff every menu change
aboutPage.problem.card2.desc: The same edit applied three times — POS menu, mobile ordering, staff briefing. Every. Single. Time.
aboutPage.problem.card3.title: Outlet data never reaches HQ
aboutPage.problem.card3.desc: Each location runs a different system. HQ waits until the end of the month to know how things actually went.
aboutPage.solutions.title: We solve it the way you actually run the business
aboutPage.solutions.lead: PurpleHere is the only platform with a native workflow for every role in the restaurant value chain — from a single shop owner to the supplier behind the supply chain.
aboutPage.solutions.singleStore.title: One screen for the entire shop
aboutPage.solutions.singleStore.problem: Mobile orders, POS, inventory, and staff scheduling all live in different apps that don't talk to each other.
aboutPage.solutions.singleStore.solution: An order placed via QR mobile flows straight to the kitchen, deducts inventory, and updates today's revenue — all in one system.
aboutPage.solutions.brand.title: 50 outlets, one source of truth
aboutPage.solutions.brand.problem: Franchisee outlets each run a different POS. Sales, recipes, and pricing drift apart, and HQ only sees the damage at month-end.
aboutPage.solutions.brand.solution: Standardize menus, recipes, and prices across the network. Real-time consolidated revenue. HQ-driven invoicing to outlets, automatically.
aboutPage.solutions.foodcourt.title: Tenants, rent, and revenue share — automated
aboutPage.solutions.foodcourt.problem: Tenant rent and revenue-share calculations live in spreadsheets. Lease renewals get missed. Tenant onboarding is manual.
aboutPage.solutions.foodcourt.solution: Floor plan with live tenant status, automatic monthly billing, revenue-share by configured terms, and a digital tenant application pipeline.
aboutPage.solutions.owner.title: All your outlets, one dashboard
aboutPage.solutions.owner.problem: You own five restaurants under different brands. Each P&L lives in a different folder, and weekly summaries take a day to compile.
aboutPage.solutions.owner.solution: A single owner dashboard rolling up every outlet you control — with weekly performance reports and an operations ticket system to chase what matters.
aboutPage.solutions.supplier.title: From PO to paid, without the paperwork
aboutPage.solutions.supplier.problem: Buyer purchase orders arrive via WhatsApp and email. Trade invoices get typed twice. Monthly statements are a Friday-night ritual.
aboutPage.solutions.supplier.solution: POs land directly in your dashboard. Trade invoices generate themselves. Monthly Statements of Account go out on schedule, in the buyer's language and currency.
aboutPage.why.title: What makes us different
aboutPage.why.lead: Most POS platforms scale by adding modules. We were built around the idea that the restaurant value chain — operators, brands, foodcourts, owners, suppliers — should run on the same data, not five different ones.
aboutPage.why.point1.title: One codebase. Six roles. No platform switch as you grow.
aboutPage.why.point1.desc: Start as a single outlet. Add a brand. Open in a foodcourt. Bring in a supplier. The platform doesn't change — your role on it does.
aboutPage.why.point2.title: Works in the browser, or install the app
aboutPage.why.point2.desc: Run PurpleHere in any modern browser and add it to your home screen in one click, or download the Android and Windows apps from the Download page. Home-screen icon and push notifications included.
aboutPage.why.point3.title: Multi-language and multi-outlet from day one
aboutPage.why.point3.desc: English, Korean, Chinese and Bahasa Malaysia. Billing in Malaysian Ringgit (RM), with multi-currency support built in for expansion. Per-outlet timezone and company info — built in, not bolted on.
aboutPage.why.point4.title: Zero data silos — one flow end to end
aboutPage.why.point4.desc: QR mobile order → POS → kitchen → inventory deduction → revenue → HQ consolidation → supplier reorder. All inside one system, no integrations to maintain.
aboutPage.cta.title: Start with the role that fits you
aboutPage.cta.subtitle: Sign up free and pick your role on the way in. Want a hands-on tour first? Browse features or talk to our team.

installPage.subtitle: Run your business as an installed app on desktop and mobile — with push notifications, offline support, and a native-app feel. No app store required.
installPage.alreadyInstalled: Purple POS is already running as an installed app on this device.
installPage.iosOldPushWarning: iOS push notifications require iOS 16.4 or later. You can still install the app and use in-app notifications, but OS-level push will not be delivered until you update.
installPage.android.heading: Install on Android
installPage.android.step2: Tap the Install button above, or open the Chrome menu and choose 'Install app'.
installPage.android.step3: The app icon will appear on your home screen. Open it and sign in.
installPage.ios.heading: Install on iPhone or iPad
installPage.ios.step1: Open dev.purplehere.com in Safari (other browsers cannot install PWAs on iOS).
installPage.ios.step2: Tap the Share icon at the bottom and choose 'Add to Home Screen'.
installPage.ios.step3: Tap Add. The app launches in standalone mode from your home screen.
installPage.macos.heading: Install on macOS
installPage.macos.step1: Open the site in Chrome, Edge, or Safari 17+.
installPage.macos.step2: Click the Install icon in the address bar, or use the Share menu in Safari and choose 'Add to Dock'.
installPage.macos.step3: The app opens in its own window with full notification support.
installPage.windows.heading: Install on Windows
installPage.windows.step1: Open the site in Chrome or Edge.
installPage.windows.step2: Click the Install icon at the right of the address bar.
installPage.windows.step3: Pin the app to your Start menu or taskbar for one-click access.
installPage.desktop.heading: Install on Desktop
installPage.desktop.step1: Open the site in a Chromium-based browser (Chrome, Edge, Brave).
installPage.desktop.step2: Click the Install icon at the right of the address bar.
installPage.desktop.step3: Open the app from your Applications or Start menu.

installPage.features.feature1.desc: New orders, kitchen alerts, payment confirmations — delivered even when the app is in the background.

accountDeletionPage.title: Delete your PurpleHere account
accountDeletionPage.subtitle: For PurpleHere and the Purple POS app (Android and Windows). Uninstalling the app does not delete your account.
accountDeletionPage.step1b: from the email address you use to sign in.
accountDeletionPage.step2: Write "Delete my account" and, if you have one, the name of your business or restaurant.
accountDeletionPage.step3: We confirm the request with you by email before deleting anything.
accountDeletionPage.ownerNote: If you are the owner of a business account, deleting it also closes the accounts of the staff under it.
accountDeletionPage.deletedBody: Your sign-in is disabled as soon as we confirm the request. Within 30 days we delete or anonymise your personal profile: name, email address, phone number, password and PIN, and your app settings.
accountDeletionPage.keptTitle: What is kept, and for how long
accountDeletionPage.keptBody: Some records must be kept by law and are used only for that purpose, as described in our Privacy Policy: transaction, sales and billing records for up to 7 years for legal and accounting purposes, and the account records needed for those obligations for up to 5 years after the account is closed. Technical logs are deleted within 12 months.

privacyPolicyPage.deletionRequestRetenti: If you request deletion, we delete or anonymise your personal profile within 30 days and keep only the records the law requires, for the periods above
